name: Drive the train to the end
desc:
🚂 Will you be able to reach the end? 🚃 
Try to drive the different trains to reach the end.
Once you pass the game you can control traffic with some signs.
Will you be able to reach the goal? Good luck!

Find the different secret badges to win new trains.
Support the game for more trains in the future.

[Last update: 22/06/26]
- Due to performance issues, some sound effects and parts of the map have been removed. However, it is not ruled out that they will be incorporated back into the game in the future.
